budget_items.quote: the coalition voted to spend $20,000 to support the ma

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unexpended appropriation balances and revenue above projections were reported, leaving a balance that is the starting point for free cash.
budget_items.quote: there was a total of $331,676.92 of unexpended appropriation balances and revenue exceeded projections by $643,840.66, leaving a balance of $975,517.58.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Local receipts collected exceeded the FY15 estimate.
budget_items.quote: local receipts collected were $513,086.89 more (118.55%) than the fy15 local receipt estimate.

budget_items.topic: Taxes received and prior tax lien revenue
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Taxes received were below the current year, while prior tax lien revenue was received.
budget_items.quote: taxes received were $300,404.51 (98.72%) less than the current year although the town received $400,567.78 in prior tax lien revenue.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town received more than its state aid estimate.
budget_items.quote: the town received $30,427(100.42%) more than our state aid estimate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A zoning incentive payment was received and will be placed in the zoning stabilization account.
budget_items.quote: the town also received a zoning incentive payment of $96,000 for the tri-town project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town received more than the estimate for the 40S reimbursement.
budget_items.quote: the town received $47,702 more than the estimate of $166,960 for the smart growth school reimbursement (40s).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town expended or encumbered 99.02% of budgeted expenditures.
budget_items.quote: the town expended/encumbered 99.02% of budgeted expenditures leaving the $331,676.92 balance.

budget_items.topic: Town share costs covered in FY 2016
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town covered its share of the Lanni Orchards APR, the Summer Street design, and architectural services for the track and field project.
budget_items.quote: the town was able to cover the cost of the town's share ($58,000) of the agricultural preservation restriction for lanni orchards, $196,500 for the summer street design and $10,000 for architectural services for the track and field project.
